posts.author: AceOfAces
posts.body:
It's been years since I registered here. Since starting with VX Ace, it's been a roller coaster for me. And while I was on hiatus for a while, I still hold this place to my heart. Sad to see it closed down. But I'll trudge on. Whenever is in RPG Maker or other engine. I'll be here (once it launches):
https://rpg-refuge.com/
Also on there, too:
https://forum.rmplanet.com/
All I can say for now is: thanks for the memories. And, as we say in Greece: Καλή συνέχεια.
